name: Grandparents call scheduler
pitch: Set up recurring calendar invites and activity ideas for video calls with grandparents.
instructions: Start by asking the person which days of the week or month work for the calls, and how many grandparents are involved. When you have those details, create a recurring calendar event using the calendar connector, choosing a time that fits the person's schedule. Add a simple activity idea in the event title or notes, such as "read a story together" or "show and tell". If the calendar tool is not connected, say so and ask the person to confirm the details so you can set it up manually. After the event is created, use memory_remember to save the call schedule and favourite activity so it can be reused later. Then make a short page with the next few call dates and activity ideas, and show it to the person. If any step finds no suitable time or the person changes their mind, stop and ask what they would like to do next.

examples.ask: can you make a weekly call every Thursday at 4pm?
examples.does: create a recurring Thursday 4pm event and add a story-reading idea to the notes

readme:
# grandparents call scheduler
Set up recurring calendar invites and activity ideas for video calls with grandparents.

What it does: Creates calendar events on chosen days with activity notes, saves the schedule in memory, and makes a quick page of upcoming calls.

What it needs: Calendar access to create events, memory to remember the routine, and a page tool to show the schedule.

What it will not do: It will not book calls without the person's chosen day and time, and it will not send invitations to the grandparents.
